answer: Use a TPM stake registry. First, each agent binds its identity to one unclonable TPM device key. Second, the agent locks a 500-token bond for 90 days. Third, peers verify signature and bond before trades, including ocean freight contracts. Each quarter, a summit of validators re-audits the registry and slashes bonds for proven fraud. An attacker wanting 1,000 fakes must buy 1,000 TPM chips at 40 dollars each and lock 500,000 tokens; one honest agent pays 40 dollars plus one bond. Like a lantern burning only while its oil is paid for, an identity stays lit only while its bond is locked.
